examples.ko: 다리 교각에 배가 부딪혔다는 뉴스를 봤어요.
examples.en: I saw news that a ship hit a bridge pier.
Many people fish under the bridge piers.
The newly built bridge pier looks sturdy.
The bridge piers were submerged because of the flood.

examples.ko: 이 다리는 교각이 열 개나 있어요.
examples.en: This bridge has as many as ten piers.
The river flows fast between the bridge piers.

explain: '다리'가 전체를 말한다면 '교각'은 강이나 땅에 서서 다리를 받치는 기둥 부분만 말해요. 일상 대화보다 뉴스나 공사, 사고 이야기에서 자주 나와요.
explain_en: While '다리' means the whole bridge, '교각' refers only to the pillars standing in the river or ground that hold it up. It appears more in news, construction and accident reports than in daily talk.

en: paralyze; numb; bring to a standstill

examples.ko: 이 약은 신경을 마비시키는 성분이 들어 있어요.
examples.en: This medicine contains an ingredient that numbs the nerves.
The heavy snow brought the city's traffic to a standstill.

examples.ko: 큰 홍수가 마을 전체를 마비시킬 정도였어요.
examples.en: The big flood was enough to bring the whole town to a standstill.

examples.ko: 독이 몸을 마비시켜서 움직일 수 없었어요.
examples.en: The poison paralyzed the body, so I couldn't move.

examples.ko: 두려움이 사람을 마비시켜 버릴 때가 있어요.
examples.en: Sometimes fear can paralyze a person.
The union tried to bring the subway to a halt with a strike.

explain: '마비시키다'는 몸의 감각이나 기능, 도시의 기능을 멈추게 할 때 써요. 원인이 되는 쪽이 주어예요. 치과에서 아픔을 없애는 주사는 보통 '마취'라고 해요. 결과를 말하면 '마비되다'를 쓰는데, '교통이 마비되다'가 뉴스에서 더 자주 나와요.
explain_en: 마비시키다 means to stop a body's sensation or function, or a city's functions. The cause is the subject. The shot a dentist gives to take away pain is usually called 마취 (anesthesia). For the result, Koreans use 마비되다, and '교통이 마비되다' (traffic is paralyzed) appears more often in the news.

examples.en: The child sits quietly and draws.
The puppy is waiting patiently.
You need to behave during class.

examples.ko: 동생은 손님이 오면 갑자기 얌전히 굴어요.
examples.en: My younger sibling suddenly behaves well when guests come.
The doctor told me to rest quietly at home.
She greeted politely and took her seat.

explain: 조용하고 점잖게 행동하는 모습에 써요. 아이나 동물에게 가장 많이 쓰고, '얌전히 있어'는 가만히 조용히 있으라고 할 때 써요. 어른에게 쓰면 '조용한 성격'이라는 칭찬이 될 수도 있고, 답답하다는 느낌도 줄 수 있어요.
explain_en: Used for behaving in a quiet, well-mannered way, most often with children and animals. 얌전히 있어 means stay quiet and behave. For adults it can praise a calm personality, or hint that someone is too stiff.

examples.en: The factory polluted the river, and the fish died.
Car exhaust pollutes the city air.

examples.ko: 쓰레기를 함부로 버려서 바다를 오염시키면 안 돼요.
examples.en: You must not pollute the ocean by dumping trash carelessly.
I'm worried the oil will contaminate the ground.

examples.ko: 그 회사는 환경을 오염시킨 벌로 큰 벌금을 냈어요.
examples.en: The company paid a big fine for polluting the environment.

examples.ko: 손으로 직접 만지면 음식을 오염시킬 수 있어요.
examples.en: Touching food with your bare hands can contaminate it.

explain: 누군가나 무언가가 원인이 되어 더럽힐 때 써요. 당하는 쪽에서 말하면 '강물이 오염되다'가 돼요. '더럽히다'는 일상에서, 오염시키다는 환경 이야기에서 더 자주 써요.
explain_en: Use it when a person or thing is the cause of making something dirty. From the side of what gets dirty, you say '강물이 오염되다'. '더럽히다' is more common in daily life, and 오염시키다 more in talk about the environment.

en: satisfy; fulfill; meet (a requirement or need)

examples.en: This product meets customers' needs.
I didn't meet the eligibility requirements, so I was rejected.
I want to satisfy my child's curiosity.

examples.ko: 조건을 모두 충족시키면 신청할 수 있어요.
examples.en: If you meet all the conditions, you can apply.

examples.ko: 새 가게는 다양한 입맛을 충족시키려고 메뉴를 늘렸어요.
examples.en: The new shop added menu items to satisfy different tastes.

examples.ko: 기준을 충족시키는 후보가 한 명도 없었어요.
examples.en: There was not a single candidate who met the criteria.

explain: 충족시키다는 요구, 조건, 기대, 호기심에 맞게 해 준다는 쪽이라 목적어에 '요구, 조건, 기준, 욕구'가 와요. 말할 때는 '맞추다'가 더 자주 쓰여요. 배고픔을 채우는 것은 '채우다'를 써요.
explain_en: 충족시키다 goes with objects like demand, condition, criterion and desire, meaning to satisfy them. In speech 맞추다 is used more often. For filling hunger, the word is 채우다.

examples.ko: 파도 때문에 해안의 침식이 심해지고 있어요.
examples.en: Coastal erosion is getting worse because of the waves.

examples.ko: 비가 많이 오면 산비탈의 침식이 빨라져요.
examples.en: When it rains a lot, erosion on the mountain slope speeds up.

examples.ko: 숲이 사라지자 토양 침식 문제가 생겼어요.
examples.en: After the forest disappeared, a soil erosion problem appeared.
This valley was formed by long-term erosion.
They planted trees on the shore to prevent erosion.

examples.ko: 강물에 의한 침식은 지리 시간에 배웠어요.
examples.en: We learned about erosion by river water in geography class.

explain: 지리나 환경 뉴스에서 '해안 침식', '토양 침식'처럼 자주 나와요. 짝말은 흙이 쌓이는 '퇴적'이에요. 글에서는 '신뢰의 침식'처럼 무언가가 조금씩 약해진다는 비유로도 써요.
explain_en: In geography and environment news it often appears as '해안 침식' (coastal erosion) or '토양 침식' (soil erosion). Its paired word is '퇴적' (deposition), when soil piles up. In writing it is also used figuratively, as in '신뢰의 침식' (erosion of trust).

examples.en: Water is gushing out of the faucet.
It rained, so the stream is rushing along.
A pipe burst and water poured out.

examples.ko: 산속 샘에서 맑은 물이 콸콸 솟아요.
examples.en: Clear water gushes from the spring in the mountains.
Please don't leave the water running full blast.
I poured the water from the kettle into the cup in a rush.

explain: 많은 양의 물이 힘차게 쏟아지거나 흐르는 모습이에요. 적은 물이 가늘게 흐르면 '졸졸', 가늘게 계속 흐르면 '줄줄'이라고 해서 양과 세기가 달라요.
explain_en: It shows a large amount of water pouring or flowing forcefully. A thin small flow is '졸졸', and a thin continuous flow is '줄줄', so the amount and strength differ.
